name: Snug: Shape Fit Puzzle
subtitle: Fit. Clear. Smile.
shortDescription: Drag colourful shapes into the gaps, pop full rows, and build each colour's signature shape for shiny rewards. A relaxed puzzle for everyone. Free, no sign-up.
longDescription:
Snug is a relaxed, cheerful puzzle for everyone. Drag colourful shapes onto the board, fit them snugly into the gaps, and watch full rows and columns pop with a satisfying burst.

Start with a gentle first few levels, then rise to real challenges. New colours join as you level up, from 3 all the way to 8, and every colour has a favourite signature shape. Build it from several pieces and it blooms for a big bonus.

### Why Players Smile
• Easy to learn: one tiny idea, fit the shape
• Journey mode with handcrafted levels, stars and goals, plus Endless play when you just want to drift
• Snug bonuses for tight fits and combos for clearing several lines at once
• Quests that ask for a colour's signature shape: square, line, corner, tee, plus, zigzag, ring and big square
• Collect polished, gilded and radiant tile finishes just by playing well, plus extra colour palettes and board skins
• Meet Snuggle, the cheerful pink mascot who cheers every combo
• Hints when you are stuck, and kind, never stressful rounds
• Daily goal and streak to make a tiny habit of smiling
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up
• Made for iPhone and iPad, with a layout that grows with your screen
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
